newsitem.title: CHINA: China's 1996 RPI seen at 6.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: China's 1996 RPI seen at 6.5 percent.

text.p: Annual retail price inflation in China for all of 1996 will be about 6.5 percent, down from an actual 14.8 percent in 1995, the China Business Times said on Saturday.
Quoting official estimates, it said retail price inflation in the fourth quarter of 1996 would rise 4.6 percent over the same 1995 period.
It said retail price inflation would rise 4.8 percent in October, 4.7 percent in November and 4.5 percent in December, down from five percent in September.
The newspaper did not say which government department the estimates came from.
The official target is to reduce annual retail price inflation in 1996 to below 10 percent.
